National Stock Numbers and their Item Descriptions:

NSN

Item Description

2530015657606

PITMAN ARM,STEERING

Maximum of the contract (including option): $1,461,525.36

This item is coded 1R and is being procured with full and open competition.

Estimated Annual Demand Quantity (ADQ) for this NSN:

NSN 2530015657606 – 1734 EA

The NAIC and Business Size Standard for this NSN is as follows:

NSN 2530015657606, 336350, Size Standard 1,500

The objective of this procurement is to place this item in a firm fixed price, indefinite delivery contract (LTC) of a maximum of five (5) years, divided into a base period of three (3) years with two (2) option periods of one (1) year. The total duration of the contract shall not exceed five (5) years. The Government will solicit the acquisition using FAR (Federal Acquisition Regulation) Part 13.5 Acquisition of Commercial Products. The scope of the procurement is limited to the item listed in Section B of the solicitation. The Government does not intend to bundle these items.

Interested persons may identify to the Contracting Officer their interest and capability to satisfy the Government's requirement.

Destination Information: CONUS

Delivery Schedule: See solicitation.

The solicitation will be available on the Internet at http://www.dibbs.bsm.dla.mil/ on or about 5/12/2026. Hard copies of this solicitation are not available.

Various Increments Solicited: see solicitation for price ranges.

TYPE OF SET-ASIDE: None
